propositions: The clean core-wheel optionality lane installs unbounded mcp, allowing PyPI to resolve unsupported mcp 2.0.0.
MCP 2.0 no longer provides mcp.server.fastmcp, which rebar imports, causing the lane to fail independently of the patchset.
The lane's MCP install must be pinned to the supported interval mcp>=1.28.1,<2 matching pyproject.toml.
The lane must continue installing the core wheel without extras and verify the agents extra is absent.
Both MCP optionality contracts must execute with supported FastMCP transport available and workflow lint must pass.
